title: Multimodal Masked Diffusion Autoencoder for Modeling Impaired Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.23211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human cognitive state (e.g., distraction, stress), gaze, and behavior interact with the driving environment in subtle ways that AI could use to assist drivers, but ground-truth labels for human cognitive state levels are costly to obtain at scale. We propose a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder, ID-MAE, that adds a self-supervised objective to impairment prediction: alongside predicting the impairment label as a masked token, it reconstructs masked gaze and trajectory. To probe the effects of different modalities and types of impairments on model inference, we introduce DIVERT, a driving-simulator dataset containing 103 hours of driving data (n = 109) with ten impairment inductions spanning cognitive, visual, and emotional states, recorded with gaze, vehicle state, and scene video. translated_title: 用于建模受损驾驶的多模态掩码扩散自编码器
translated_abstract: 人类认知状态（如分心、压力）、注视与行为会以微妙的方式与驾驶环境相互作用，AI 可以利用这些信息来辅助驾驶员，但大规模获取人类认知状态水平的真实标注成本高昂。我们提出了一种多模态掩码扩散自编码器 ID-MAE，它在受损驾驶预测中引入了自监督目标：除了将受损标签作为掩码 token 进行预测外，模型还重建被掩码的注视数据和车辆轨迹。为了探究不同模态和不同类型受损状态对模型推理的影响，我们引入了 DIVERT——一个驾驶模拟器数据集，包含 109 名受试者的 103 小时驾驶数据，涵盖认知、视觉和情绪三类状态下的十种受损诱发方式，并以注视、车辆状态和场景视频的形式进行记录。我们展示了 ID-MAE 在 DIVERT 数据集和现有数据集上均能显著提升受损驾驶推断的效果……
tldr: 该论文提出多模态掩码扩散自编码器 ID-MAE，通过自监督方式重建被掩码的注视与轨迹数据来增强受损驾驶预测，并发布了包含 109 人、103 小时驾驶数据及十种受损诱发条件的大规模模拟驾驶数据集 DIVERT，显著提升了受损驾驶推断效果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ID-MAE, a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder that augments impairment prediction with self-supervised reconstruction of masked gaze and trajectory data, and introduces DIVERT, a large-scale driving-simulator dataset with 103 hours of data from 109 participants and ten impairment inductions, achieving significant improvements in impaired-driving inference.
